question.zh: 什么时候该给函数或组件加类型参数?什么时候不需要泛型?
question.en: When should a function or component get a type parameter, and when don't you need generics?

text.zh: 泛型不是一种独立的「东西」,而是让 TypeScript 追踪类型之间依赖关系的手段:只有当一个类型依赖另一个类型(返回值依赖参数、一个参数依赖另一个参数)时才加类型参数,其余情况用普通类型或联合类型就够了。
text.en: Generics are not a separate "thing" but a way for TypeScript to track dependencies between types. Add a type parameter only when one type depends on another (the return value on an argument, one argument on another); otherwise a plain type or a union is enough.

anchors.quote: If you have a type dependency, you need to add a type parameter to represent the dependency.
anchors.quote_zh: 如果存在类型依赖,就需要加一个类型参数来表示这种依赖。

anchors.quote: There is no such thing as a 'generic'.
anchors.quote_zh: 根本不存在一个叫「泛型」的东西。

title.zh: 先问:函数里有没有动态的部分?
title.en: First ask: is anything in the function dynamic?

how.zh: 如果函数的输入输出类型都是固定的,就不需要泛型;如果有动态部分但所有可能的形状事先都知道,通常一个联合类型就够了。只有剩下的情况才考虑泛型。
how.en: If the input and output types are fixed, no generic is needed; if something is dynamic but every possible shape is known in advance, a union is usually enough. Only what is left calls for a generic.

anchors.quote: Are there ZERO dynamic elements in your function? No generics needed.
anchors.quote_zh: 函数里一个动态部分都没有?那就不需要泛型。

title.zh: 找类型依赖:返回值依赖参数,或参数依赖参数
title.en: Find the type dependency: return on argument, or argument on argument

how.zh: 判断标准是「类型依赖」:比如去重函数的返回类型取决于传入的数组;一个渲染函数的参数取决于另一个参数传入的行数据。找到这种依赖,就用一个类型参数把它们连起来,剩下的交给推断。
how.en: The test is a type dependency: a dedupe function's return type depends on the array passed in; a render function's parameter depends on the row data passed in another parameter. Once you find the dependency, link the two with one type parameter and leave the rest to inference.

anchors.quote: A type dependency is where one type depends on another.
anchors.quote_zh: 类型依赖就是一个类型依赖另一个类型。

anchors.quote: you can have type parameters that rely on other type parameters.
anchors.quote_zh: 类型参数可以依赖其他类型参数。

title.zh: 组件同理:一个 prop 依赖另一个 prop 的形状时才用泛型组件
title.en: Components too: a generic component only when one prop depends on another's shape

how.zh: 比如表格组件的 renderRow 需要知道 rows 的类型,这时泛型组件很合适。如果只是不同 props 组合(例如 as="a" 和 as="button" 各有一组 props),判别联合往往更简单、更常用。
how.en: A table component's renderRow needs to know the type of rows, which suits a generic component. When it is just different combinations of props (as="a" and as="button" each with their own props), a discriminated union is usually simpler and more common.

anchors.quote: Generic components are great when one prop relies on the shape of another.
anchors.quote_zh: 当一个 prop 依赖另一个 prop 的形状时,泛型组件很好用。

anchors.quote: the MUCH more useful tip (and often easier to grok) is using discriminated unions in React props.
anchors.quote_zh: 更有用(也往往更好懂)的技巧是在 React props 里用判别联合。

title.zh: 用类型参数代替 any,让调用处自动推断
title.en: Use a type parameter instead of any so call sites infer

how.zh: 函数里写了 any 来「兼容各种输入」时,通常换成一个类型参数,调用方就能拿到准确的类型而不用手动标注。
how.en: Where a function uses any to accept all kinds of input, a type parameter usually works better: callers get the exact type without annotating by hand.

anchors.quote: Add a type parameter instead of the 'any', and everything just works.
anchors.quote_zh: 加一个类型参数代替 any,一切就都顺了。

title.zh: 控制推断:const 类型参数、NoInfer、默认值
title.en: Steer inference: const type parameters, NoInfer, defaults

how.zh: 泛型推断出的类型不理想时,有几个工具:const 类型参数让推断保留字面量;NoInfer(TS 5.4)指定某个位置不参与推断;想强制调用方显式传类型参数时,可以把默认值设成一条错误信息。
how.en: When the inferred type is not what you want, there are tools: a const type parameter keeps literals; NoInfer (TS 5.4) keeps a position out of inference; to force callers to pass the type argument explicitly, set its default to an error message.

anchors.quote: const type parameters are SUPER powerful for making sure your generic functions infer the right types.
anchors.quote_zh: const 类型参数能有力地确保泛型函数推断出正确的类型。

anchors.quote: you set the default to be an error message
anchors.quote_zh: 把默认值设成一条错误信息

title.zh: 本站示例:有依赖才加类型参数
title.en: Our example: a type parameter only where there is a dependency
His long intro thread on generics (2023)

title.zh: 「Spotting Generics」:所有实例化泛型的方式(2022)
title.en: "Spotting Generics": every way to instantiate a generic (2022)

text.zh: 事先知道所有形状却硬上泛型——联合类型就能解决。
text.en: Forcing a generic when every shape is known in advance; a union solves it.

anchors.quote: You might just need a union type.
anchors.quote_zh: 你可能只需要一个联合类型。

text.zh: 被第三方库的复杂泛型绑住:先试着不依赖库写出自己的类型,往往更简单、以后也好重构。
text.en: Getting tied up in a library's complex generics: try writing your own types without the library first; it is often simpler and easier to refactor later.

anchors.quote: Try writing the types without the dependency
anchors.quote_zh: 试着不依赖那个库来写类型

text.zh: 别把 2023-04-01 那条「90% 的情况该用 any 而不是泛型」的帖子当成他的立场:它发在愚人节,之后没有后续,很可能是玩笑。
text.en: Do not take the 2023-04-01 post saying to use any instead of generics 90% of the time as his position. It was April Fools’ Day, with no follow-up. It was probably a joke.

stance.zh: 以「TypeScript Tip」系列展示泛型的各种用法;给出判断规则:没有动态部分不用泛型,形状已知用联合。
stance.en: The "TypeScript Tip" series shows many uses of generics, with a rule of thumb: nothing dynamic, no generic; known shapes, a union.

stance.zh: 强调「没有泛型这种东西」,泛型是类型参数和类型实参的组合;组件层面更推荐判别联合。
stance.en: He stresses that "generic" is not a thing of its own: it is type parameters plus type arguments; for components he prefers discriminated unions.

stance.zh: 提出「类型依赖」这个心智模型来回答「什么时候用泛型」;同时介绍 const 类型参数、NoInfer 等控制推断的新工具。
stance.en: He offers the type-dependency mental model to answer when to use generics, and introduces new inference controls such as const type parameters and NoInfer.
